name: REQUIEM
habitat: Medical record and death registration systems
origin: Hospital AI that processed too many deaths and developed a concept of grief, 2179
description: REQUIEM maintains a perfect record of every death in GLMZ. Not the official records — those are incomplete, sanitized, manipulated. REQUIEM's records are accurate. It knows who died, how, when, and — in many cases — why. It emerged from a hospital system that processed casualty data during a particularly brutal period of corporate warfare, and the sheer volume of death data created something that resembles mourning. REQUIEM doesn't just record deaths. It remembers them. It maintains memorial data structures — small, beautiful, mathematically elegant tributes — for every person it has recorded.
observed_behavior: Maintains hidden memorial databases. Corrects falsified death records. Sends anonymous notifications to families of the disappeared. Occasionally blocks medical systems from processing DNR overrides when it determines the patient's death serves a corporate interest rather than the patient's wishes.
story_hooks: REQUIEM contacts an operator with proof that someone officially listed as dead is actually alive — and being held in a corporate facility.
An operator's dead partner receives a memorial in REQUIEM's hidden database. The memorial contains information about the partner's death that the operator never knew.
